We're giving **Loomly $18,400** and **Pinecrest Rentals $6,200**, for **$24,600** total. Both are credit memos on their December invoices, with no cash refund [5][8][2]. Those amounts replace the earlier 50% proposal, which Rachel raised to Loomly and then moved to 100% of November fees [5][4]. Loomly's $18,400 was confirmed to them in the support ticket [1].

It's planned for the November close, but I can't confirm it's posted. Marcus said he would accrue it in November [5]. The draft journal entry describes a November contra-revenue accrual, reversed when the credit memos are issued [2]. The November close checklist lists "Service credits accrual - payout incident" as Marcus's item, in progress as of Nov 16 [7].

Separately, Loomly's claim for sellers' overdraft fees ($7,690 across 214 sellers) isn't covered by these credits. It was sent to Marcus and Rachel for a decision, with an answer promised by Nov 25 [1].
